Why does the Bay of Bengal produce so many cyclones? Are cyclones becoming more intense because of climate change? And can meteorologists accurately predict where a cyclone will make landfall?
In this interview, veteran meteorologist Prof. S.S.V. Ramakrishna explains the science behind cyclone formation, the role of El Niño, ocean temperatures, river runoff, and climate change. He also discusses why the Bay of Bengal is more cyclone-prone than the Arabian Sea and shares insights into the path and intensity of tropical cyclones.
Thank you for watching our video!
